verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS automation platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an open-source license or a public source repository for Zapier. npm-distributed SDK and CLI packages and published OpenAPI specs are adjacent artifacts, not the product's source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
